summary: Keep browser outbox IndexedDB operations within the supported Promise baseline

replay.detail: Dispatch permits, retry policy and outcome retention are unchanged.

schema.detail: No browser or server schema changes.

compatibility.detail: IndexedDB opening and transactions use standard Promise constructors instead of Promise.withResolvers, preserving the existing ES2023 kit and browser baseline without raising the configured library target. A synthetic test field is renamed without changing its recovery assertions.

downtime.detail: No service interruption or restart is required.

manual.detail: No operator actions or configuration changes are required.

recovery.detail: Existing corrupt-record quarantine, discard and transaction-completion durability behavior are unchanged.
